findings.highlight: why don’t you donate some blood while you’re here
findings.evidenceJa: 献血でもしていったらどうですかフハハハハ
findings.governingReading: why not donate some blood while you are here—fwahahahaha
findings.explanation: The doctor’s exaggerated laugh in Taiga’s reenactment disappears, flattening her comic performance.

findings.highlight: In terms of horse racing, this development is the dark horse
findings.governingReading: In racing terms, this outcome was a long shot
findings.explanation: A low-probability betting outcome is replaced by a surprising competitor.

findings.highlight: all the students were taken to the hospital
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れた生徒は色んな病院に運ばれた
findings.governingReading: the students who collapsed were taken to various hospitals
findings.explanation: The English says the entire student body was hospitalized and collapses multiple hospitals into one.

findings.highlight: most people should have recovered yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 個人差はあるけど昨日中には回復した筈
findings.governingReading: There were individual differences, but they should have recovered by the end of yesterday
findings.explanation: An account qualified by differences in recovery time becomes a claim only about a majority.

findings.highlight: has gone to all the hospitals in this town
findings.evidenceJa: 今朝まで、町中の病院をかけまわってきた
findings.governingReading: had been running around the hospitals across town until this morning
findings.explanation: The duration and Taiga’s exhausting movement among hospitals are lost.

findings.highlight: the students on the first floor classrooms
findings.evidenceJa: 一階の教室[line3]三年Ａ組とＢ組の生徒たち
findings.governingReading: the students in the first-floor classrooms—third-year classes A and B
findings.explanation: The exact cohorts who suffered the worst effects disappear.

findings.highlight: as long as Caster’s Master is there
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターのマスターがいる以上
findings.governingReading: as long as Caster has a Master
findings.explanation: The Master’s existence is changed into presence at the school, adding an unsupported location.

findings.highlight: The students are talking about what happened yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 顔見知りとあった途端昨日の話をしだし
findings.governingReading: The moment students meet someone they know, they begin talking about yesterday
findings.explanation: The observed social mechanism by which the incident dominates school chatter disappears.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka, standing there like an angry devil
findings.evidenceJa: 仁王立ちで立っている遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka standing planted there in a guardian-statue stance
findings.explanation: Rin’s broad-legged, immovable posture is mistranslated as resemblance to an angry demon.

findings.governingReading: the middle of the school gate
findings.explanation: Rin’s position blocking the school entrance is moved into a road.

findings.highlight: Caster is at the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に巣を張ってるキャスター
findings.governingReading: Caster has spun her nest at Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: Rin’s predatory image of Caster nesting at the temple is flattened into location.

findings.highlight: Monks can’t live without collecting alms
findings.evidenceJa: 檀家まわりあっての僧門
findings.governingReading: A temple survives through making the rounds of its parishioner households
findings.explanation: Rin’s practical claim about maintaining parishioner relations becomes begging for alms.

findings.evidenceJa: 現実的な推測を無視する
findings.explanation: Rin’s claim that her theory is practically grounded becomes a claim that it is self-evidently true.

findings.highlight: let me get away from here
findings.evidenceJa: ここから撤退させてくれ
findings.governingReading: let me get us out of here
findings.explanation: Shirou’s effort to withdraw Rin from the public scene becomes his own escape.

findings.governingReading: things gather there far too easily
findings.explanation: A property that makes something gather too readily is changed into an already accumulated quantity, prematurely fixing the process.

findings.highlight: coming here everyday with a cool face
findings.evidenceJa: 涼しい顔でやってきている
findings.explanation: The idiom for Issei’s unconcerned composure is rendered as facial temperature or appearance; “everyday” is also inserted.
Shirou’s comic assessment of Rin’s eagerness to fight Issei loses the combative half.

findings.highlight: I realize that she might have been worried about me
findings.governingReading: Only after an absurd delay do I realize that she may have been worried about me
findings.explanation: The joke and characterization in Shirou’s very late recognition of Rin’s concern disappear.
